Monique travels a distance of 960 km, some distance by train and rest by bus. Monique takes 7 hours if she travels 600 km by train and rest by bus. She takes 7 hours 20 minutes when she covers 560 km by bus and rest by train, then what is the speed of the train?
questions.solution_en:
Let speed of train be t km/h and speed of bus be b km/h

600/t + 360/b = 7 ---(1)

And 400/t + 560/b = 22/3 ---(2)

Solving both equations, we get

t = 150 km/h and b = 120 km/h

questions.q_en: A shopkeeper sold similar article to his two customers A and B. To customer A he allows, two successive discounts of 10% and 20% respectively while to customer B he allows, two successive discounts of 15% each. The difference between the selling price of article B to A is Rs.4. If the marked up per cent of the article is 60% above its cost price, then what is the profit amount earned by shopkeeper when he sold the article to customer B?
questions.solution_en:
Let the marked price of the article = 100x

Selling price of article to customer A after two successive discounts = 90% of 80% of 100x = 72x

Selling price of article to customer B after two successive discounts = 85% of 85% of 100x = 72.25x

According to question-

72.25x - 72x = 4

0.25x = 4

x = 16

Selling price of article to customer B after two successive discounts = 72.25x = Rs.1156

Marked price of article = 100x = Rs.1600

Cost price of article = 1600 * (100/160) = Rs.1000

Profit amount when the article is sold to B = 1156 - 1000 = Rs.156

questions.q_en:
Read the data carefully and answer the following question.

Following pie-chart represents the percentage break-up of number of students in class XI in schools A, B, C and D.

Following table represents the ratio of number of girls to boys in class XI in respective schools.

SchoolRatio of number of girls to boys in class XI
A2: 3
B5: 3
C3: 1
D4: 5

In school B, if the number of boys in class XI and XII are in the ratio 3: 4 respectively and in school C, the number of girls in class X and XI are in the ratio 1: 2 respectively, then what is the ratio of number of boys in class XII in school B to the number of girls in class X in school C?
questions.solution_en:
Let the total number of students in class XI in schools A, B, C and D together = n

Then, total number of students in class XI in school B = 16% of n = 0.16n

Total number of students in class XI in school C = 32% of n = 0.32n

Number of boys in class XI in school B = 0.16n * 3/(3 + 5) = 0.06n

Number of girls in class XI in school C = 0.32n * 3/(3 + 1) = 0.24n

Now, number of boys in class XII in school B = 0.06n * 4/3 = 0.08n

And the number of girls in class X in school C = 0.24n * 1/2 = 0.12n

Therefore, ratio = 0.08n: 0.12n = 2: 3

SI = P x 5 x 2/100 = 0.1P

CI = P(1+5/100)2 - P = 0.1025P

(0.1025 - 0.1)P = 24

=> 0.0025P = 24

=> P = 9600

When the interest is compounded half yearly,

Amount after 2 years = 9600 x (1 + 2.5/100)4 = 10596.60

CI = 996.60

SI = 960

Difference = 36.60

questions.q_en: If the 7-digit number 39475y4 is divisible by 24, then the value of y will be -
questions.solution_en:
If the number 39475y4 is divisible by 24, then it must be divisible by 3 and 8.

Divisibility by 3: 3 + 9 + 4 + 7 + 5 + y + 4 = 32 + y

Possible values for y are 1, 4, 7.

Divisibility by 8: 514, 544 and 574 must be divisible by 8.

Since, 544 is divisible by 8, then y = 4

There are three metals named as A, B, and C. The ratio of weight of metal A to that of metal C is 25: 1 and the ratio of weight of metal B to that of C is 17: 1. In what ratio metals A and B be mixed so that the ratio of weight of mixture to weight of metal C is 19: 1?
questions.solution_en:
Given,

The ratio of weight of metal A to that of metal C is 25: 1.

Therefore, metal A is 25 times as heavy as metal C.

Similarly, metal B is 17 times as heavy as metal C.

Required ratio = (19 - 17)/ (25 - 19) = 2/6 = 1: 3

Find the radius of the base and height of a cylinder if curved surface area and volume of the cylinder are 2112 cm2 and 25344 cm3, respectively. (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution_en:
Given, curved surface area and volume of the cylinder are 2112 cm2 and 25344 cm3, respectively.

So, 2 * 22/7 * r * h = 2112

=> rh = 336

And 22/7 * r2 * h = 25344

=> 22/7 * r * 336 = 25344

=> r = 25344 * 7/22 * 1/336

=> r = 24 cm

Hence, h = 336/24

=> h = 14 cm

Rakesh and Vijay entered into a partnership with investment in the ratio 9:4 respectively. Vijay is the working partner and Rakesh is the sleeping partner. After one year, Vijay doubled his investment. At the end of two years, they earned a profit of Rs.80000. Vijay being the working partner, one fifth of the profit goes to him for his work and rest of the profit is divided among them as per the ratio of their shares in the profit. Find the share of Rakesh in the profit.
questions.solution_en:
Let, initial amounts invested by Rakesh and Vijay be Rs.9k and Rs.4k respectively.

Ratio of shares in the profit:

Rakesh : Vijay = (9k x 2) : (4k + 8k)

= 18k : 12k

= 3:2

Share of Rakesh in the profit = 3/(3 + 2) x (1 - 1/5) x 80000

= 3/5 x 4/5 x 80000

= Rs.38400

Manish, Nakul and Pintoo alone can complete a certain work in 21 days, 28 days and 15 days, respectively. Manish and Pintoo started the work together while Nakul joined them after 5 days and worked with them till the completion of the work. For how many days did Nakul work?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 21, 28 and 15 = 420 units

Efficiency of Manish = 420/21 = 20

Efficiency of Nakul = 420/28 = 15

Efficiency of Pintoo = 420/15 = 28

Work done by Manish and Pintoo in 5 days = 5(20 + 28) = 240 units

Remaining work = 420 - 240 = 180 units

Time taken by all three persons to complete remaining work = 180/(20 + 15 + 28) = 20/7 = 2(6/7) days

Hence, Nakul did the work for 2(6/7) days.

questions.q_en: If x > 0 and x4 + 1/x4 = 3842, then find x7 + 1/x7?
questions.solution_en:
x4 + 1/x4 = 3842

According to formula -

If a2 + 1/a2 = n, then a + 1/a = √(n + 2)

x2 + 1/x2 = √(3842 + 2) = √3844 = 62

x + 1/x = √(62 + 2) = √64 = 8

x3 + 1/x3 = 83 - 3*8 = 488

Now,

x7 + 1/x7 = (x4 + 1/x4)(x3 + 1/x3) - (x + 1/x)

= 3842*488 - 8

= 1874888
